allResults.question: HOTSPOT - You develop a test method to verify the results retrieved from a call to the Computer Vision API. The call is used to analyze the existence of company logos in images. The call returns a collection of brands named brands. You have the following code segment. For each of the following statements, select Yes if the statement is true. Otherwise, select No. NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
allResults.explanation: YYN. Statement 1 (Yes): The code checks brand.Confidence >= .75, so only brands with 75%+ confidence are displayed. Statement 2 (Yes): brand.Rectangle.X and brand.Rectangle.Y are the top-left corner coordinates of the bounding box. Statement 3 (No): The code prints brand.Rectangle.X (again, not X+W) and brand.Rectangle.H (height, not Y+H). Bottom-right corner would require (X+W, Y+H). See: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/computervision/3.1/detect-objects/detect-objects?tabs=HTTP#boundingrect
